newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Nord lifts Tritton copper/gold find.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Nord lifts Tritton copper/gold find.

text.p: Nord Pacific Ltd said on Friday that test drilling has enabled it to boost by about one third the resource base at its Tritton copper project in New South Wales.
Measured, indicated and inferred resources currently stand at 9.75 million tonnes, grading 3.01 percent copper, 0.21 grammes of gold and 11 grammes of silver on a per tonne basis, the company said.
This equates to 293,000 tonnes of copper, 66,000 ounces of gold and 3.1 4 million ounces of silver, Nord said.
"Tritton could become a low cost producer of copper, with by-product precious metals credits," Nord Pacific president Pierce Carson said.
More detailed feasibility work will be carried out in 1997, with initial production possible in early 1999, he said.
Tritton is a 50-50 joint venture with Straits Resources Ltd.
Nord Pacific is a subsidiary of Nord Resources Corp
